nodes.name: Organized-network operating functions (comparison framework)
nodes.note: Analytical checklist derived from documented cartel investigations: command/delegation; communications; finance; logistics; recruitment/exploitation; protection/influence; and post-capture evidence. This is a research framework, not a claim that every function is established in the Epstein record.

nodes.name: The Epstein Index (independent archive)
nodes.note: Independent open-source reading room that collects DOJ, House Oversight, and court releases; OCRs and indexes records; links people/events to original PDFs. OCR and automated summaries can err; original document is authoritative. Not a finding of wrongdoing.

nodes.name: Epstein Transparency Project
nodes.note: Independent project parsing DOJ Datasets 9 and 11 into person searches, timelines, and email-network visualizations. Inclusion/contact is not evidence of wrongdoing; verify parsed headers and every edge against source PDFs.

nodes.name: Yirah Epstein Search
nodes.note: Search interface for a large Epstein document corpus and email archive. OCR/search results are discovery aids; verify claims against original records and distinguish mentions from direct contact.

nodes.name: The Epstein Project (archive/search)
nodes.note: Independent archive with semantic search, document discovery, and investigative reports. Treat summaries and AI retrieval as leads; cite underlying documents for graph edges.

nodes.name: Epstein Document Archive
nodes.note: This archive was retired in May 2026; its former indexed records may still be useful as leads, but do not treat the service as currently active.

nodes.name: Epstein Archive (OCR reading room)
nodes.note: Independent searchable OCR archive of public records with links to source scans. Use for discovery and return to original scans for verification.

nodes.name: Jeffrey E. Epstein 2018 Trust
nodes.note: Trust agreement dated 8 May 2018. The agreement names Jeffrey Epstein as grantor and Darren Indyke, Richard Kahn, and Kathryn Ruemmler as trustees. A trustee role is a fiduciary/legal role; this record alone does not establish knowledge of or participation in abuse.

nodes.name: Jeffrey E. Epstein 2019 Trust
nodes.note: Trust agreement dated 18 January 2019. It names Jeffrey Epstein as grantor and Darren Indyke and Richard Kahn as trustees, and expressly revokes the 2018 trust. The trust instrument records intended fiduciary roles and provisions, not proof that every bequest or payment was ultimately made.

nodes.name: Karyna Shuliak
nodes.note: Named in reporting on Deutsche Bank KYC records as added to the Butterfly Trust beneficiary roster on 9 December 2014, replacing Ghislaine Maxwell. This is a trust/financial relationship; it does not by itself establish knowledge of or participation in crimes.

nodes.name: Pent Holdings, Inc.
nodes.note: Named in the 2015 all-family-entities schedule: Leon D. Black is listed as director, shareholder and president; Debra R. Black as secretary. The schedule explicitly says incorporation documents were not available and does not establish shareholder powers. The 2017 art inventory lists Pent Holdings as owner of J.M.W. Turner’s Seascape: Folkestone.

nodes.name: AP Narrows LP
nodes.note: Delaware limited partnership documented in its 2016 partnership agreement. Partners include Leon D. Black, the APO-01 Trust, the APO-B Trust and Narrows Holdings LLC; Narrows Holdings LLC is identified as Class A general partner. The agreement records contributed art by all partners except APO-B Trust.

nodes.name: Narrows Holdings LLC

nodes.name: APO-01 Trust

nodes.name: APO-B Trust

nodes.name: The Haze Trust

nodes.name: DOC_EFTA02468795 — Boothbay Capital follow-up
nodes.note: Dataset 11 · 21 Mar 2016. Email chain discusses whether a previously described capital drawdown schedule remained intact or whether a meeting should occur first. No amount or completed drawdown is established in the extracted text.

nodes.note: Dataset 11 · 29 Jun 2015. Email from Ari Glass to Jeffrey Epstein proposes a staged $25 million call-down schedule ($2m, $7m, $7.5m and $8.5m). The underlying investment vehicle is not identified in the extracted text and no drawdown is confirmed.

nodes.name: Bella Klein
nodes.note: Research lead only. rhowardstone/Epstein-research-data lists Bella Klein in its persons registry as staff, describing her as a long-time accountant and administrative employee (source attribution in that registry: la-rana-chicana). Its extracted-name index reports 285 document hits and provides a sample of EFTA identifiers. Its separate communications_db export aggregates 11 counterpart relationships (312 emails in total); those counts have not been checked against the underlying messages in this pass. A separate research narrative alleges: EUR 1,000 via Western Union (EFTA00716763, 28 Apr 2011); reimbursement of EUR 2,700 (EFTA00642502, Jul 2014); relocation funding for a Barcelona apartment (EFTA00679056, Apr 2017); and a wire route to a Dubai account involving Bella Klein/Richard Kahn (EFTA00711038, Jun 2017). These are unverified secondary-source claims here: the DOJ PDFs were not readable through the current browser session, and no financial-transaction edge is asserted. Do not infer wrongdoing from staff status, document mentions, or communications.

node_notes.boothbay: About $38M in from Epstein 2014–17; forced redemption after the 2019 arrest (WSJ). Dataset 11: Named in a March 2016 email chain about a capital drawdown schedule and allocations. The extracted email does not establish the underlying fund or a completed drawdown.
